review: See docs/handoff/security-2026-09/client-lifetime.html for sensitive input/result custody. Source hashes pin the reviewed uncached operations, session boundaries and plaintext lifetime; changes require source review before refreshing pins. OAuth2 #609 merge custody review: GitHub starts and writes remain one-shot; same-origin state-bound continuation and the optional local-factor CLI remedy from security remediation are retained; write-only editor secrets clear on submission, settlement, unmount and retirement. Issue #861 focus lifetime review: Values and MatrixRowEditor clear disclosed plaintext and announcements on blur/visibilitychange; focus generations reject late reveal results. Uncached mutations, ceremony task checks and session retirement boundaries remain intact. Issue #861 popup follow-up: pin the shared focus lifetime owner; authorized reveals wait for task-owned focus restoration, capture generation at dispatch, and report metadata-only audit feedback for discarded results. #807 developer delegation review: only scope/lifetime/key consent metadata enters the transaction query; TOTP uses sensitive state cleared before the one-shot mutation, passkey finish preserves the session epoch guard, and authorization codes remain in the ephemeral sensitive mutation. The browser neither mints nor caches a developer bearer, and generic OIDC/reveal windows cannot authorize this delegation. Invitation claim #610 custody review: the establish page's authority stays in useSensitiveState and leaves only as the `proof` of a one-shot purpose-claim start through useSensitiveMutation (no retained result); it never enters a URL, the return channel or storage, which hold only the same-origin return path keyed by the provider state; a refused start keeps it in sensitive state exactly as a refused password establishment does. Codex R1 follow-up: a successful claim start wipes the authority and both password fields before location.assign, and a persisted pagehide wipes them too, so a back-forward-cache restore from the provider never brings a live authority back. Browser demo review: build-only role restrictions and disabled polling preserve normal-mode behavior. Matrix, history and Values edits do not alter uncached sensitive mutations, plaintext retirement, session epochs or focus remasking. Fake fixtures are isolated in the demo build and reset on reload. Read-only demo expansion review: adapter detail close and SCIM selection are browse-only; Remotes refuses workspace preparation in demo before any transaction and disables external launch/download paths. Existing credential custody and retirement remain unchanged. Invitation claim #610 BFCache review: successful provider departure and persisted pagehide also clear the provider contacting label; authority/password custody and one-shot claim proof remain unchanged. Invitation claim #610 DOM retirement review: provider beforeLeave and persisted pagehide synchronously clear the authority and both password input DOM values before queuing the existing sensitive state cleanup; contacting reset and all claim/recovery guards remain intact. Browser departure instrumentation records only input lengths, never plaintext. UI review branch (2026-10-13, ui-review): NOT markup-only. CLI login #612 custody review: the transaction query holds only state or human user code and display metadata, never a device bearer or session artifact.
